n1fc189ad62.headline: Czech Republic has a plan to fight drought. It brings revolutionary proposals, also addresses water price increases | Aktuálně.cz
n1fc189ad62.summary: The Czech government presented a revolutionary plan addressing drought defense measures and potential water price increases for the coming years.
n1fc189ad62.why: Water scarcity and pricing reforms have significant implications for agriculture, industry, and households, impacting the Czech economy.
